title: Harnack inequality for mixed local-nonlocal weighted homogeneous equations
summary: We consider the following class of mixed local-nonlocal equations: \begin{equation}\tag{P}\label{eq:P} -Δ_p u + (-Δ)_p^s u = V |u|^{p-2}u \text{ in } Ω, \end{equation} where $s \in (0,1), p \in (1, \infty)$, and the weight function $V$ lies in scaling subcritical Lebesgue space $L^q(Ω)$ where $q>d/p$ when $d>p$ and $q>1$ when $d \le p$. We establish the Harnack inequality for a weak solution and the weak Harnack inequality for a weak supersolution to \eqref{eq:P}.
